notes: Chroma Audio Suite v2.9.2: ChromaCore & ChromaCorePro v2.8.3 preset library overhaul, zero-ringing Scream/Acid filter limit-cycle protection, stereo pan centering on legacy patches, and 8 new flagship Studio Signature presets.

ChromaCore.notes: ChromaCore & ChromaCorePro v2.8.3: Eliminated perpetual filter limit-cycle self-oscillation on Scream Overdrive (Type 10) and Acid 303 (Type 12) presets, fixed Chroma Vowel II Vocal Lead filter mapping, centered stereo pan on legacy presets, and added 8 new Studio Signature presets (Daft French Touch Talkbox, Afterlife Melodic Techno Lead, Riddim Sub Womper, Prophet-6 Analog Poly Brass, UK Garage Organ Sub Bass, Future Flume Granular Chords, Interstellar Zimmer Cathedral, Hardwave Cyber Reese Lead).

ChromaCorePro.notes: ChromaCorePro v2.8.3: Eliminated filter limit-cycle self-oscillation on Scream/Acid presets, fixed legacy preset filter indices and stereo pan centering, and added 8 new Studio Signature presets.

ChromaPulse.notes: ChromaPulse v2.8.0: FabFilter Pro-Q 3 acoustic mixing zone backdrop (7 zones), stack-allocated spectrum bars & EQ curves with DrawLines, cut-filter vertical Q dragging, double-click node reset to 0 dB, Pillar 1 targeted dirty-rect invalidation, and 0.002f Shift-fine precision.

ChromaDeep.notes: ChromaDeep v2.8.0: 7 Pro-Q 3 acoustic mixing zone backdrops, stack-allocated spectrum and EQ curves with FillPolygon and DrawLines, highpass/lowpass vertical Q dragging, targeted dirty-rect timer invalidation, 0.002f Shift fine precision, and Universal Auto-Updater Shield.

ChromaX.notes: ChromaX v2.8.0: Pillar 1 zero-lag dirty-rect timer invalidation, zero background noise on clean presets (kParamNoise1Level = 0.0f), Pillar 3 polyphonic headroom scaling, 0.002f Shift-fine knob precision, and Universal Auto-Updater Shield.

ChromaComp.notes: ChromaComp v2.0.0: FabFilter Pro-Q 3 acoustic mixing zone backdrop (7 mixing zones), zero-lag stack-allocated polygon spectrum & EQ curves with DrawLines (zero cubic spline stalls), HP/LP vertical Q resonance dragging, double-click node reset to 0 dB, targeted rcEq dirty-rect invalidation, and 0.002f Shift-fine precision.

ChromaVerb.notes: ChromaVerb v2.9.0: 8x8 Fast Walsh-Hadamard (FWHT_8) unitary mixing matrix for 100% delay line cross-coupling per pass, alternating sign decorrelation injection (kInSign), orthogonal stereo late taps, forward 2x octave-up shimmer loop with C1 polynomial Hann window, and FabFilter Pro-Q 3 acoustic mixing zone backdrop.

ChromaDelay.notes: ChromaDelay v2.0.0: FabFilter Pro-Q 3 acoustic mixing zone backdrop (7 mixing zones), zero-lag stack-allocated polygon spectrum & EQ curves (zero heap allocations in WM_PAINT), flat 0.0 dB default EQ bands with Pro-Q 3 HP/LP vertical Q dragging, targeted dirty-rect invalidation, and 0.002f Shift-fine precision.

ChromaFhaser.notes: ChromaFhaser v2.8.0: 7 Pro-Q 3 acoustic mixing zone backdrops, stack-allocated DrawLines on waterfall depth slices and EQ curves, cut-filter vertical Q dragging, targeted dirty-rect timer invalidation, 0.002f Shift fine precision, and Universal Auto-Updater Shield.

ChromaSlice.notes: ChromaSlice v2.8.0: Targeted dirty-rect timer invalidation, 0.002f Shift fine precision, active knob dirty-rect invalidation, zero-allocation filter Bode response, and Universal Auto-Updater Shield.

ChromaTransientShaper.notes: ChromaTransientShaper v2.8.0: Quantum differential transient engine with targeted dirty-rect timer invalidation, 0.002f Shift fine precision, active knob dirty-rect invalidation, and Universal Auto-Updater Shield.

ChromaVoice.notes: ChromaVoice v3.2.0: WARP Granular OLA transient preservation with differential envelope follower, sharp consonant plosive micro-window phase locking, direct transient punch crossfade, and zero-transcendental C1 polynomial Hann window.

ChromaWidener.notes: ChromaWidener v2.8.0: Targeted dirty-rect timer invalidation, 0.002f Shift fine precision, active drag dirty-rect invalidation, persistent backbuffer zero-leak rendering, and Universal Auto-Updater Shield.

ChromaDesigner.notes: ChromaDesigner v2.8.0: Dual 500-series D.E.T. transient processor with targeted dirty-rect invalidation, 0.002f Shift fine precision, active knob dirty-rect invalidation, and Universal Auto-Updater Shield.
